categories.main_business_segments: By-Health Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the dietary nutritional supplements (VDS) industry, focusing on the production and sales of vitamins, minerals, plant extracts, and other bioactive substances. The company offers a full range of VDS products including tablets, powders, capsules, and other forms, and has developed multiple sub-brands targeting various health needs such as immune enhancement, women's health, bone health, and vitamins. It also operates through multiple sales channels including offline retail pharmacies, supermarkets, mother and baby stores, and diversified online e-commerce platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes strong technological capabilities with over 451 patents including 130 invention patents related to raw materials and formulas. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as continuous solid formulation intelligent production lines and has established a transparent factory management system certified globally. R&D focuses on new functional and heavy functional products, anti-aging, precision nutrition, and biosynthesis technologies, collaborating with top research institutes like the Chinese Academy of Sciences. Quality control is stringent, adhering to national and international standards including GMP, ISO, and TGA certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: By-Health serves a broad consumer base focused on health-conscious individuals across China and internationally. Its products target consumers seeking nutritional supplements for immune support, metabolic health, liver protection, bone and joint health, and cognitive function. The company’s key markets include domestic retail pharmacies, supermarkets, and online platforms such as Tmall, JD.com, and social commerce channels. It also has a significant presence in overseas markets including Australia, Hong Kong, Vietnam, the USA, Malaysia, and Indonesia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant business in Hong Kong and Australia. It has subsidiaries and operations in multiple countries including Vietnam, the United States, Malaysia, and Indonesia. The company’s production facilities are located in Zhuhai, China, and Australia, supporting both domestic and international sales. Its e-commerce presence spans major Chinese platforms and cross-border channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: By-Health operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the dietary supplement supply chain. It controls product development, manufacturing, and sales, including direct production in its own factories and some OEM arrangements. The company sources high-quality raw materials globally and manages a comprehensive supply chain to ensure product quality and traceability. It distributes products through a mix of direct sales, distributors, and e-commerce platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a strong technology-driven enterprise by 2030, emphasizing scientific nutrition and innovation. R&D priorities include developing proprietary patented raw materials and formulas, new functional and heavy functional products, and advancing anti-aging and precision nutrition research. It invests in digital transformation, AI applications, and smart manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency. The company also focuses on brand strengthening, channel optimization, and sustainable growth through quality product innovation and consumer-centric strategies.
categories.revenue_model: By-Health generates revenue primarily through product sales of dietary nutritional supplements across multiple channels. Sales are conducted via a combination of distribution (buyout and consignment models) and direct sales, especially in online flagship stores on major e-commerce platforms. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but the core revenue is from product sales to consumers through retail and online channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: By-Health holds the leading market position in China’s dietary nutritional supplements industry with a 9.3% market share as of 2024. It competes with international and domestic brands in a highly competitive market, especially with the rise of live-streaming e-commerce and new media channels. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, patented products, high-quality manufacturing, and a broad multi-brand portfolio. It is recognized as a benchmark and leader in the industry, focusing on scientific nutrition and innovation to maintain its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, By-Health reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.84 billion, a 27.3% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 653 million, down 62.6%. The company experienced a decline in sales volume and revenue due to intensified competition and slower product upgrades. Total assets stood at RMB 14.28 billion with net assets of RMB 11.05 billion. Despite recent challenges, the company maintains a significant scale and continues to invest in R&D and digital transformation for future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: By-Health emphasizes delivering high-quality, scientifically validated nutritional supplements with a focus on consumer health value. Its value proposition centers on 'scientific nutrition' with proprietary patented raw materials and formulas, rigorous quality control, and advanced manufacturing technologies. The company aims to provide differentiated products with new functions and heavy functions, supported by clinical research and collaborations with top scientific institutions. Its brand DNA stresses integrity and quality, producing products safe enough for family and friends, thereby building strong consumer trust and brand loyalty.
